profile.stagger_pattern: 5 at-large seats, 4-year terms, staggered 2/3. Two seats up in Nov 2018, 2022, 2026; three seats up in Nov 2016, 2020, 2024. Members are seated (oath of office) at a December meeting following certification of the canvass: 2020-12-14, 2022-12-12, 2024-12-09 are documented.
profile.election_month: November (even years, consolidated statewide under SB 415)

run_log.detail: Read agent-brief.md and the California section of state-registry.md. Registry's Alameda pattern alamedacountyca.gov/rovresults/{ID}/indexA.htm is PARTLY WRONG: indexA.htm 404s for the newer elections. IDs 248 (2022) and 252 (2024) serve at /rovresults/{ID}/index.htm instead; 236 (2018) and 241 (2020) use indexA.htm. Registry IDs 241/248/252 confirmed correct; 236 = Nov 2018 discovered by probing.

5 at-large seats, 4-year staggered terms: 2 seats in 2018/2022/2026, 3 seats in 2016/2020/2024, all even-year November. Alameda County archive floor established by sweeping IDs 215-256: nothing before 233 exists (215-232 all 404), so NOV 2016 RESULTS ARE NOT ON THE COUNTY SITE. 253 exists but is empty; 254-256 404, so no 2026 election page yet (election is 2026-11-03, still future as of 2026-08-17).

2018 (id 236): McQuaid 4,716 / Nason 4,245 elected, Preston Jordan 4,009 third. 2020 (id 241): Jordan 6,254, Gary 5,400, Tiedemann 5,393 elected; Tod Abbott 4,906 fourth. RCV races (2022, 2024) needed the underlying data file, which loadrcv.js reveals: /rovresults/rcv/{ID}/{City}/{RaceCode}/RcvDetailedReport.xml -- a NEW verified pattern not in the registry; the rcvresults.htm page itself renders nothing to a fetcher.

RCV FIRST-ROUND LEADER TRAP CONFIRMED LIVE in 2022. First choices: Miki 2,152, Hansen-Romero 1,814, Lopez 1,642, Pilch 1,237, Garrett-Pinguelo 314. Final round 4 (threshold 2,338): Lopez 2,396.14 and Miki 2,355.00 both cross; Hansen-Romero 2,260.96 does NOT. Winners are MIKI and LOPEZ -- reading the first-round table would have seated Hansen-Romero two years early and dropped Lopez entirely. 2024 round 4 (threshold 2,002): Jordan 2,037.95, Hansen-Romero 2,002, McQuaid 2,002 elected; Tiedemann 1,823.99 defeated.

PrimeGov API unlocked the city archive despite the census recording it as an iframe-only, robots-blocked portal. Working endpoints on albanyca.primegov.com: /api/v2/PublicPortal/ListArchivedMeetings?year=YYYY (year param REQUIRED -- 404 without it) and /api/meeting/search?from=M/D/YYYY&to=M/D/YYYY. Documents fetch as real PDFs at /Public/CompiledDocument/{documentId}; /Portal/viewer?id=&type= returns only a sign-in shell. Full council archive 2018-2026 recovered at zero search cost.

EVERY PrimeGov council document dated before ~Nov 2020 is an image-only scan: pdftotext returns 0 bytes for the 2018-12-03, 2018-12-17, 2019-01-07, 2019-01-22, 2019-11-04, 2019-11-18, 2019-12-02, 2019-12-16, 2020-01-14 and 2020-01-21 minutes. Text extraction begins with the 2020-11-02 minutes. The city's own site (www.albanyca.gov / .org) is behind Akamai and 403s curl on every path including /robots.txt.

MAJOR REGISTRY CORRECTION -- California DOES have a statewide municipal officials source. The California Roster (Secretary of State) publishes an annual 'Incorporated City and Town Officials' section naming Mayor, Vice Mayor and every council member for all 480+ cities. URLs: https://admin.cdn.sos.ca.gov/ca-roster/2019/02j-city-town.pdf (2019 filename) and https://admin.cdn.sos.ca.gov/ca-roster/{YYYY}/cities-towns.pdf for 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, 2026. 2023 403s under every filename tried. This single series is an annual roster spine for the entire California portion of the corpus and directly contradicts the registry's 'No statewide source -- sos.ca.gov is state/federal only'.

CA Roster staleness check, the failure mode the brief warns about for ACFRs. Roster values: 2019 Mayor Nason/VM McQuaid; 2020 Mayor Pilch/VM McQuaid; 2021 Mayor Gary/VM Jordan; 2022 Mayor Gary/VM Jordan; 2024 Mayor Miki/VM Lopez; 2025 Mayor Lopez/VM McQuaid; 2026 Mayor McQuaid/VM Hansen-Romero. All agree with dated minutes EXCEPT 2022, which is a STALE CARRY-OVER of the 2021 edition -- minutes prove Jordan was Mayor and Tiedemann Vice Mayor throughout 2022. The 2022 roster edition was not used for any tenure row.

2019 roster confirmed twice, independently. (1) CA Roster 2019: Mayor Rochelle Nason, Vice Mayor Peggy McQuaid, Council Nick Pilch, Michael Barnes, Peter Maass. (2) Verbatim roll call, 2019-02-04 minutes, via a SECOND live archive the census did not record: albanyca.granicus.com/MetaViewer.php?view_id=&event_id=976&meta_id=109855 returns a text-extractable PDF -- 'Present: Council Members Barnes, Maass, and Pilch, Vice Mayor McQuaid, Mayor Nason.' Granicus serves the pre-2020 era that PrimeGov only holds as scans. Sweeping meta_id +/- 350 around that value returned the same unrelated AUSD document each time, so the id space was not enumerable cheaply and the Dec 2018 reorganization minutes were not located.

ONE mid-term change in the window: Council Member Ge'Nell Gary resigned. She is present and honored at the 2022-11-07 regular meeting (item 4-1, 'Resolution in Appreciation of Council Member Ge'Nell Gary'); by the 2022-11-09 special meeting the roll is four and the sole agenda item is 'Appointment Process for Filling a Vacant City Council Seat'. Council adopted vacancy-filling procedures on 2022-11-15 and appointed Jennifer Hansen-Romero, who was sworn in with the two election winners on 2022-12-12 ('Ceremonial Oath of Office for Newly Elected and Appointed Members of the City Council - John Anthony Miki, Robin D. Lopez, and Jennifer Hansen-Romero'). Note the structural tell: Hansen-Romero LOST the Nov 2022 RCV race and entered by appointment five weeks later, then won a full term in 2024.

CAVEAT, NOT A GAP: Gary's exact resignation effective date was not sourced. Last documented in office 2022-11-07; seat documented vacant 2022-11-09. end_date recorded as 2022-11-07. The seat was lawfully vacant roughly 2022-11-08 to 2022-12-12, inside a 2022 seat-year that is otherwise fully sourced, so per the brief this is filed here rather than as a gap row. Targeted searches for the resignation date returned nothing; Albany NY / Albany OR dominate unscoped results and the Nov 9 and Nov 15 2022 agendas do not recite an effective date.

No other mid-term change 2019-2026. Continuity is checked against roll calls at 2019-02-04, 2020-11-02, 2020-11-16, 2020-12-07, 2020-12-14, 2020-12-21, 2021-12-20, 2022-11-07/09/15/21, 2022-12-05/12/19, 2023-12-04, 2023-12-18, 2024-11-18, 2024-12-02/09/16, 2025-11-17, 2025-12-01, 2025-12-15 and 2026-01-20, plus seven CA Roster editions. McQuaid appears (2019-2022), vanishes (2023-2024) and reappears (2025-2026): this is GENUINE, not a missed appointment -- her 2018 term ended 2022-12-12 and she was off the council until re-elected 2024-11-05 and sworn in 2024-12-09.

Mayoral rotation reconstructed from primary reorganization minutes, never inferred from vote totals. 2020-12-14: nominations contested -- McQuaid for Mayor FAILED 2-3, Gary for Mayor carried 5-0, Jordan elected Vice Mayor. 2021-12-20: queue advanced Vice Mayor Jordan to Mayor, Tiedemann to Vice Mayor. 2022-12-12: reorganization item at the seating meeting; 2022-12-19 roll call reads 'Vice Mayor Miki, Mayor Tiedemann'. 2023-12-18: motion 'to appoint John Miki as Mayor and Robin Lopez as Vice Mayor'. 2024-12-09: Jordan DEFERRED his queue place to McQuaid 'as she received the most votes in the election'; Lopez appointed Mayor, McQuaid Vice Mayor. 2025-12-15: Jordan again deferred, to Hansen-Romero; McQuaid appointed Mayor, Hansen-Romero Vice Mayor. The queue is therefore not mechanical -- deferrals happen twice -- so no year's officers were extrapolated.

The 2024-11-18, 2024-12-09 and 2024-12-16 minutes extract as mojibake: every printable character is shifted by -29 (a font-encoding artifact, not ROT13/ROT47). Adding 29 recovers clean text, which also arrives with all spaces stripped ('CouncilMembersHansenRomero'), exactly the extraction quirk the brief describes. Decoded rather than recorded as unreadable.

SEAT-LABEL CONVENTION. All five seats are at-large and unnumbered; no source assigns a seat identity. 'At-Large Seat 1-5' are analytical labels chosen to carry term-class lineage: Seats 1-2 are the 2018/2022/2026 class, Seats 3-5 the 2016/2020/2024 class. Within a class the pairing of a departing member to their successor is arbitrary and should not be read as a sourced fact; the class assignment itself IS sourced (by which cycle each person won). Seat 3 is anchored by the Gary -> Hansen-Romero vacancy chain, which is documented.

BOUNDARY DATES. In-window handovers use documented seating/reorganization dates (2020-12-14, 2021-12-20, 2022-12-12, 2023-12-18, 2024-12-09, 2025-12-15). Pre-window starts for the 2016 and 2018 classes use the ELECTION date (2016-11-08, 2018-11-06) because the December 2016/2018 seating minutes are image-only scans; this is conservative and affects no 2019-2026 seat-year. Two exceptions carry an inferred date: the Nason mayoralty and the McQuaid vice-mayoralty are given start 2018-12-10, the City Council Special Meeting that matches the city's documented election-year seating pattern (2020-12-14, 2022-12-12, 2024-12-09). Their 2019 office-holding is sourced twice over; only the start date is inferred. The Pilch mayoralty / McQuaid vice-mayoralty boundary of 2019-12-16 is likewise inferred, from the city's non-election-year pattern of reorganizing at the SECOND December regular meeting (2021-12-20, 2023-12-18, 2025-12-15); the CA Roster brackets it correctly (Nason Mayor in the 2019 edition, Pilch Mayor in the 2020 edition) and the 2020-11-02 and 2020-12-07 minutes confirm Pilch as Mayor through 2020.

CYCLE 2016-11-08 FLAGGED. The Alameda County results archive does not reach 2016 (IDs 215-232 all 404). The three seats it filled are nevertheless fully sourced for 2019 and 2020 by the CA Roster 2019/2020 and the 2019-02-04 and 2020-12-07 roll calls, so the flag costs ZERO seat-years of coverage; only the vote record is missing. CYCLE 2026-11-03 FLAGGED because it has not happened yet -- today is 2026-08-17. Two seats (Miki, Lopez) are up. All of calendar 2026 to date is covered by the sitting five; if that election seats anyone new in December 2026 those partial-year tenures will need to be added later.

7 seat-labels (5 at-large + Mayor + Vice Mayor) x 8 years = 56 seat-years, all covered by tenure rows. Zero gap rows. Zero low-confidence rows. Council size is 5 throughout 2019-2026 -- no CVRA districting shift here, unlike Ojai and Yuba City.
